proposedRules.proposal: Named features with their own level/choice/source are candidates; paragraphs, containers, lore and table rows do not automatically become acquired capabilities.
Subclass is a choice parent; catalog presence does not grant every subclass or child feature.
An ASI catalog observation can have several class-level occurrences; event/history instances do not duplicate catalog identity or reapply imported choices.
Keep both original parent/source observations and permit a shared reference view only with bounded evidence; no canonical alias from a repeated title.

limits: Counts are selected observations/proposed representation roles, not accepted units or the whole class catalog.
Existing source IDs/basis/order/parents are preserved, not proven by this proposal.
Observation-to-canonical cardinality is not fixed: version evidence may require splitting, while supporting references may be shared without deleting original observations.
